summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Occasions & Characters facet feature (backend + frontend). All backend APIs pass. Frontend admin pages, product editor, storefront sections, and shop filtering all functional.

integration_issues.issue: URL doesn't update immediately with character parameter when toggling filter (but results update correctly)
integration_issues.note: Functionality works correctly (results show 3 products with both filters active), only URL check timing issue

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/occasions returns 8 active occasions sorted by order
Backend: GET /api/characters returns 12 active characters sorted by order
Backend: GET /api/products?occasion=office filters correctly (6 products)
Backend: GET /api/products?character=fresh filters correctly (4 products)
Backend: Multi-value filtering ?occasion=office,gym works (7 products)
Backend: Admin login with Bearer token
Backend: GET /api/admin/occasions returns all occasions
Backend: POST /api/admin/occasions creates new occasion with slug+id
Backend: PUT /api/admin/occasions/{id} updates name/icon/order/active
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/occasions/{id} deletes unused occasion
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/occasions/{id} blocks deletion of in-use occasion with HTTP 400
Backend: POST /api/admin/characters creates new character
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/characters/{id} deletes unused character
Backend: PUT /api/admin/products/{id} persists occasions and characters arrays
Frontend: Admin login at /admin works
Frontend: Sidebar navigation shows 'Occasion' and 'Karakter' links under Katalog group
Frontend: /admin/occasion page renders table with 8 rows
Frontend: 'Tambah Occasion' button opens dialog with name field and save button
Frontend: /admin/karakter page renders table with 12 rows
Frontend: Admin Product Editor /admin/produk/prd_greenbasillime shows Occasion chips (9 chips)
Frontend: Admin Product Editor shows Character chips (12 chips)
Frontend: Toggling facet chip and clicking Simpan saves without error
Frontend: Storefront homepage shows 'Shop by Occasion' section with 9 chips
Frontend: Storefront homepage shows 'Shop by Character' section with 12 chips
Frontend: Clicking occasion chip navigates to /shop?occasion=office
Frontend: /shop?occasion=office shows filtered results with '6 produk ditemukan' header
Frontend: Shop page shows Occasion and Character filter sections in left sidebar
Frontend: Toggling character filter chip updates results (3 products with both filters)
